items.question: When is Webflow better than WordPress?
items.answer: When you want a faster launch, precise visual control and polished animation, without managing servers or plugins.

items.question: Is it easy to edit the content in Webflow?
items.answer: Yes, through CMS Collections and the on-page editor, within the fields we define for your team.

items.question: Does animation slow the website down?
items.answer: We only use light, purposeful animation, and we respect the reduced-motion setting on the visitor's device.

items.question: Does Webflow support Arabic and RTL?
items.answer: Yes. We set up the text direction, Arabic fonts and page structure so everything displays correctly.

items.question: What about hosting?
items.answer: Hosting is provided by Webflow itself, so you don't need a separate server or plugin updates.

items.question: Can I move the website to another platform later?
items.answer: The content can be exported, but moving a website between platforms means rebuilding the front end and planning redirects.
